applyTo: "README.md,TEAM-STATUS.md,SESSION-HANDOFF.template.md,notes/**/*.md,inventory/**/*.md,inventory/**/*.json,data/**/*.json,config/**/*.json"

# Notes And Data Instructions

- Keep framework text generic and public-safe; do not inject private environment details.
- Preserve example-first structure: Markdown explains operator intent and JSON carries machine-readable shape.
- If a concept is represented in both docs and JSON, update both layers in the same change.
- Keep sample paths, hostnames, and role names coherent across README, inventory, and notes examples.
- Mark assumptions and planned work clearly so roadmap notes are not mistaken for verified state.
- Prefer additive updates over destructive rewrites in continuity notes and project examples.
